languagePack.auto: Follow the editor's display language. The pack stays installed.
languagePack.chinese: Simplified Chinese for the editor and Cursor interface. The pack stays installed.
languagePack.english: Built-in English. The pack stays installed; switch back without reinstalling.
languagePack.description: Display language for the Cursor interface. Changing this writes only the `locale` field of `argv.json` and offers to restart. The pack stays installed, so you can switch languages without reinstalling. To remove it, uninstall the extension and set the display language to English.
